findings.element: Overview after the last required store fix (banner, store badge 'Ready', Sync block Enable)
findings.finding: When location and the Created product setting are done, the setup banner disappears and the store badge flips to 'Ready', so nothing tells the user that sync is still off and they must click Enable in another column.
findings.user_impact: Same pattern as KF-2: users take setup as the whole job and leave with sync Disabled, so no stock changes are ever sent.
findings.suggested_fix: While sync is Disabled and at least one store is ready, keep a banner such as 'My ceramic plates is ready — enable sync to start sending stock changes' with the Enable button inside it, and label the store badge 'Ready, sync off'.

evidence.action: State 1, L1: connected My ceramic plates, chose Warehouse in California in Choose location and saved, then clicked Open Settings.
evidence.observed: The 'build … needs setup before it receives changes. Show' banner is gone; the store badge reads 'Ready'; the only remaining cue is the grey 'Disabled' chip and Enable button in the middle Sync column (x=593), away from the store card the user just finished (x=932).

findings.element: Events tab › Held row 'Item not matched · Match it' → Mappings tab
findings.finding: Fixing a Held change via 'Match it' ends on the Mappings tab at 'Every product is matched.' with no mention of the held change, which stays Held until the user returns to Events and clicks 'Retry held and failed'.
findings.user_impact: Users believe fixing the match released the stock change, so the +12 stays unsent and Shopify stock stays wrong.
findings.suggested_fix: After a mapping that resolves a held change, show 'Plate seconds is matched — 1 held change can be sent now' with a Retry button on the Mappings tab (or retry it automatically).

evidence.action: State 2: clicked the Held count (1), then 'Match it' on Bill #1045 Plate seconds (B-grade), picked a QuickBooks item for Plate seconds.
evidence.observed: View changes to '5 of 5 matched · by SKU, then by name … Every product is matched.' with toast 'QuickBooks item mapped.' and only a 'Back to overview' link; setMap does not touch events, so the Held count stays 1 until 'Retry held and failed' is clicked on Events.

findings.element: Shopify stores card › 'Connect store' button vs fix-row buttons and Enable
findings.finding: 'Connect store' is a filled primary button in every overview state, while the required actions (Choose location, Open Settings, Match products) are small outlined buttons, and in the ready state it has the same weight as Enable.
findings.user_impact: During setup the strongest call to action is connecting another store instead of finishing this one, splitting attention away from the steps that unblock sync.
findings.suggested_fix: Make 'Connect store' an outlined secondary button so the primary weight falls on the current open fix-row action or, once a store is ready, on Enable.

evidence.action: Viewed L1 'S1 after connecting My ceramic plates' and 'S1 store ready, sync off'.
evidence.observed: Setup state: Enable is disabled, so the only filled button on the page is 'Connect store' (class btn) at the bottom of the stores card, while 'Choose location' and 'Open Settings' are btn-outlined btn-sm; ready state: 'Enable' and 'Connect store' are both filled btn.

findings.finding: 'Ignore' acts immediately with no confirm and no undo, right next to 'Accept QuickBooks' which does confirm; once ignored, the Actions cell shows '–'.
findings.user_impact: A mis-click hides a real stock difference with no way back until a quantity changes, so the user cannot resolve it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Undo to the 'Ignored until one of the quantities changes.' toast and keep an 'Undo ignore' action in the row while it is Ignored.

evidence.action: Reconcile tab: clicked 'Ignore' on Mug set (+2, Unresolved), then Compare now; compared with 'Accept QuickBooks' on Ceramic plate 24cm.
evidence.observed: Accept opens a dialog with Cancel; Ignore applies instantly, row shows Resolution 'Ignored' and Actions '–' (still Ignored after Compare now), no control to reverse it.

gaps: Run now only toasts, so whether a manual check updates Pending/Applied counts is unknown
No Failed sample events, so the Failed state, its reason text and Retry for Failed were never reached
Shopify install redirect is simulated by an in-page loader; failure or cancel on return from Shopify was not exercised
Accept QuickBooks while sync is Paused or Disabled: it creates a Pending event, but whether it is ever sent (and what the user is told) was not exercised
Connect store (second store) dialog: second_interaction=false, so cancel/re-pick behaviour is unconfirmed
Banner 'Show' link is not recorded in the state map; its behaviour was read from source (scrolls to first not-ready store) rather than observed
